svg.title: Workflow: Deliver Notification
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram. A durable notification intent is processed idempotently in one transaction and fanned out to recipient rows; dispatchers lease rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so workers scale out without double-sending. Messages: 1. notification intent; 2. consume; 3. → DLQ, commit offset; 4. skip duplicate; 5. INSERT audit row; 6. fan out recipient rows; 7. commit offset; 8. claim ≤ 20 EMAIL rows; 9. send; 10. status = SENT; 11. retry_count + 1.
svg.text: A durable notification intent is processed idempotently in one transaction and fanned out to recipient rows; dispatchers lease rows
with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so workers scale out without double-sending.
DB error → no commit, Kafka redelivers
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED · lease 10 min
The lease is just next_retry_at: a crashed worker's rows become claimable
again after 10 minutes, and SKIP LOCKED keeps concurrent dispatchers off
Result: Each recipient is emailed at most once per idempotency key, with bounded retries
